page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture, running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 25% for multi-core CPU performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests. It also shows strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Single-core performance, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput fall within the average range. Cryptographic and database operations also score in the top 25%, while LLM inference speeds are strong for small models but average for medium-sized models.

The qualitative cost profile of this instance reflects its high resource density, offering a balanced allocation of dedicated compute cores and memory without the added expense of bundled local storage or GPU accelerators. This makes it a cost-efficient option for parallelized, non-storage-intensive workloads. Appropriate applications include multi-threaded software compilation, database operations, image processing, ray tracing, and small-scale language model inference.
